description: Implementation of filesystem management functions for mounting, unmounting, opening, reading, writing, and managing file systems within Zephyr OS. Handles registration of file system types, mount point management, and file operations.

methods.name: registry_clear_entry
methods.description: Clears a registry entry by setting its file system pointer to NULL.

methods.name: registry_add
methods.description: Adds a new file system type and its implementation to the registry.

methods.name: registry_find
methods.description: Finds a registry entry by file system type.

methods.name: fs_type_get
methods.description: Retrieves the file system implementation for a given type.

methods.name: fs_get_mnt_point
methods.description: Finds the mount point matching a given path.

methods.name: fs_open
methods.description: Opens a file given its name and flags.

methods.name: fs_close
methods.description: Closes an open file.

methods.name: fs_read
methods.description: Reads data from an open file.

methods.name: fs_write
methods.description: Writes data to an open file.

methods.name: fs_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in an open file.

methods.name: fs_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in an open file.

methods.name: fs_truncate
methods.description: Truncates an open file to a specified length.

methods.name: fs_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes an open file's state.

methods.name: fs_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory stream.

methods.name: fs_readdir
methods.description: Reads the next directory entry.

methods.name: fs_closedir
methods.description: Closes a directory stream.

methods.name: fs_mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new directory.

methods.name: fs_unlink
methods.description: Removes a file.

methods.name: fs_rename
methods.description: Renames a file or directory.

methods.name: fs_stat
methods.description: Gets status information about a file or directory.

methods.name: fs_statvfs
methods.description: Gets filesystem statistics.

methods.name: fs_mount
methods.description: Mounts a filesystem at a specified mount point.

methods.name: fs_unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a filesystem.

methods.name: fs_readmount
methods.description: Reads mounted filesystems information.

methods.name: fs_register
methods.description: Registers a new filesystem type.

methods.name: fs_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a filesystem type.
